title: Easier to find
summary: The planner hasn't changed. The landing page has - so that people looking for a wedding seating chart actually end up on it.
i1: The landing page now answers the common questions: how to lay out the tables and seat the guests, whether the app is free, whether it reads a guest list from Excel, whether you can print the table plan, and whether two of you can plan together.
i2: The landing page headings now say plainly what this is - a wedding guest planner and seating chart - instead of only hinting at it.
